resources.string: Turns USB debugging on when a USB data cable to a computer is connected, and off when it is unplugged, so banking apps work when the phone is not on the cable.
Turn USB debugging on and off automatically

Connect the phone to the computer with USB debugging on, then grant it once from Twinput on the computer, or run this command:
Battery usage: restricted. The phone may stop this app in the background. Set it to Unrestricted.
Auto Blocker is on. It can turn USB debugging off by itself, so automatic switching may not work. Turn it off in Settings > Security and privacy > Auto Blocker.
On Samsung phones, Auto Blocker (Settings > Security and privacy) can turn USB debugging off by itself. Keep it off while you use this app.
